environment.description: Staging deployment on EKS cluster (us-west-2). Split.io SDK initialized with API key sdk-stg-def456. The feature flag 'inventory-search-v2' has a single targeting rule: attribute 'env_context' equals 'staging' → treatment 'on', with default rule also set to 'on' and traffic allocation 100% to 'on'. The Split SDK is configured with impressionListener that logs all evaluations. Note: the SDK operates in 'consumer' mode reading from Split Synchronizer sidecar (Redis-backed), so flag definitions are cached locally and evaluated without network calls. The SplitClientConfig has a destroyOnShutdown=false setting and connectionTimeout of 1500ms. Database is PostgreSQL 14.2 with identical schema. Spring Boot 2.7.14 with default error handling. No WAF or network-level SQL filtering is deployed on this environment's ALB.
